controles.affirmation: Titre : 'Etau reglementaire : sept procedures actives visant les pratiques commerciales'
controles.verbatim_source: Le 10-Q T2 2026 (Note 13) et l'argument lui-meme n'enumerent que six procedures : CNMC (Espagne), Swiss PSO, DGCCRF (France), Hellenic Competition Commission (Grece, juin 2025), Hungarian Competition Authority (aout 2025), FTC/Priceline. Les statuts DMA/DSA ne sont pas des procedures.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par 'six procedures ou enquetes actives'.

controles.affirmation: 'Depuis juillet 2026, une procedure de la FTC americaine visant Priceline pour pratiques trompeuses'
controles.verbatim_source: In July 2026, the Federal Trade Commission (the "FTC") staff informed Priceline that they intend to recommend that the FTC files a complaint against Priceline and a business-to-business affiliate partner ... asserting unfair or deceptive business practices ... Priceline does not agree with the FTC's position and remains in discussions to resolve the matter.
controles.correction_proposee: 'Depuis juillet 2026, les services de la FTC ont informe Priceline de leur intention de recommander a la FTC le depot d'une plainte pour pratiques commerciales deloyales ou trompeuses ; aucune plainte n'a ete deposee et des discussions sont en cours.'

controles.affirmation: Amende CNMC provisionnee a 472 M$, assortie de restrictions sur les clauses de parite et les criteres de classement
controles.verbatim_source: it recorded a liability for this matter with $472 million and $485 million included in "Other long-term liabilities" ... as of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025
controles.correction_proposee: Contexte manquant mais non contradictoire : 'In February 2025, the Spanish National Court ruled that the CNMC decision, including payment of the fine, is suspended pending the outcome of the appeal.'

controles.affirmation: Decision suisse ordonnant de reduire le niveau moyen de commission en Suisse
controles.verbatim_source: In 2025, Booking.com received a negative decision ordering a reduction of its average commission level for hotels located in Switzerland
controles.correction_proposee: Contexte manquant : l'ordre du Swiss PSO est suspendu pendant l'appel et ne serait effectif que trois ans apres un jugement final defavorable.

controles.affirmation: Injonction francaise (DGCCRF) imposant a Agoda de modifier ses pratiques d'ici octobre 2026 ; enquetes Grece (juin 2025) et Hongrie (aout 2025)
controles.verbatim_source: The DGCCRF issued a final order to Agoda to change certain of its business practices by October 2026 ... In June 2025, the Hellenic Competition Commission opened a formal investigation ... In August 2025, the Hungarian Competition Authority opened an investigation

controles.affirmation: Actions privees sur les clauses de parite : hotels allemands, deux fondations neerlandaises, risque Espagne/France/Royaume-Uni
controles.verbatim_source: German hotels filed parity-related claims against Booking.com and that litigation is ongoing ... In the Netherlands, two Dutch foundations filed such claims on behalf of European hotels and consumers, respectively, with the consumer claim further alleging that Booking.com and Agoda employed misleading practices

controles.affirmation: Lettres de credit et garanties bancaires passees de 874 M$ a 1,3 Md$, emises principalement a des fins reglementaires et de contentieux
controles.verbatim_source: The Company had $1.3 billion and $874 million of standby letters of credit and bank guarantees ... obtained primarily for regulatory purposes and in connection with certain of the litigation matters disclosed above
